name: Terminal
author: Brett
description: Windows-style terminal: a Windows Terminal window with its own tab strip (rename, colour, drag to reorder, duplicate, move to a new window), a command toolbar and Windows keys. Claude Code tabs open on any connection (console container, VPS root, any container, axHub) through a connection picker; right-click a tab for its Connection manager. Claude Code profiles (model, permissions, flags, folder, first prompt, colour, default connection). Live settings: colour schemes, font, cursor, line height, padding, bell, scrollback, startup, tab width. Mouse mode, Mosh mode, copy/paste, phone key row, idle timeout and a session log. Settings → Plugins → Terminal. Persistent tabs: VPS and console tabs live in tmux sessions that survive reloads, sleep and restarts (Open in Moshi copies the attach command; closing detaches, Kill session ends one). Headless builds open their own tab with the agent, model, live cost and status, split into the session and its context chain. Sessions nav (left rail, collapsible): My sessions (Brett's own tmux / Claude Code sessions, mirrored read-only with Jump in; claude.ai chat and voice sessions as a live feed of their console_session_note lines and console MCP calls), Agents (headless builds with agent, model, live cost, status), Connections and Recent, live over a websocket.
